adaptations.reason: The source labels3.4 on the left gap and3.2 across the rectangle, implying radius5 and height√22.44; sourceanswer3 instead treats3.4 as radius. Preserved actual shown measurement ranges and corrected the answer value.

independent_solution.method: The rectangle is centred on the diameter. Radius=3.4+3.2/2=5. Height=sqrt(5²-1.6²)=sqrt22.44≈4.7m.
